name: Cerys Grym
source:
My closest friend and [url=/c146899]Cymhen[/url]'s eldest granddaughter. We met after Cymhen got me into the same university she attended. It took very little time for us to become integral parts of each other's lives.

She left for her wardship with the Gryms' partner family, the Fayes, just after she graduated. I retreated into isolation shorty after, and it's been five years since I last saw her.

She's also, apparently, my new fiancée, as Cymhen plans for me to join the family by marrying her.

[In game description]
